title: 伸縮式の鋼製サポート支柱
description: 工事中の建物や資材置場の背景に配置する伸縮式支柱。実際に開いた高さピン穴と上下板の穴、外筒・内筒、ねじ状の調整部、回転ハンドル、固定ピンと短い脱落防止鎖を造形。床・上部荷重・支保工全体、伸縮・回転は含みません。荷重・座屈・固定や施工条件を検証した実用品設計ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.315 × 2.242 × 0.230 m、7,924三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A telescopic support-prop exterior for construction interiors and storage yards, with real height-pin and plate openings, inner/outer tubes, thread-like adjustment detail, turning handle, locking pin and short captive chain. Floor, supported load, complete shoring system and motion are absent. This is not a real design validated for loading, buckling, anchorage or construction conditions. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.315 × 2.242 × 0.230 m; 7,924 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
